guideTitle: How to get your free API Keys in 1 minute
guideSpeedSteps: Search 'PageSpeed Insights API' and click Enable.
Go to Credentials -> Create credentials -> API key and paste it here.
guideGeminiSteps: Sign in with your Google account.
Click 'Create API key', copy it, and paste it here.
